name: Whole milk
foamingProperties: Froths well and gives dense, stable foam
description: A classic choice for cappuccino and latte. The fat content varies by brand and is listed on the packaging.

name: Skim milk
foamingProperties: Creates voluminous foam easily, but it is usually airier and less creamy
description: Milk with very little fat. Its lighter taste allows the coffee notes to stand out more.

name: Oat milk
foamingProperties: Depends on the brand; "barista" editions usually froth better
description: One of the most common plant-based alternatives in coffee shops. It pairs well with espresso.

name: Soy milk
foamingProperties: Usually froths well; may curdle in very hot or acidic coffee
description: A plant-based alternative to cow’s milk. Avoid overheating soy milk when preparing coffee drinks.

name: Almond milk
flavorProfile: Nutty, with a hint of sweetness
description: A light plant-based alternative with a nutty accent. It suits cold drinks.

name: Coconut milk
foamingProperties: Foam is usually light and short-lived
description: A plant-based alternative with a noticeable coconut aroma. It adds a tropical touch to a drink.

name: Lactose-free milk
texture: Similar in texture to regular milk
foamingProperties: Usually froths similarly to regular milk
description: Cow’s milk in which lactose has been broken down into simpler sugars. It is suitable for people who have difficulty digesting lactose.
